name: Kishi Koujirou
source:
"Even a cool guy like me can't help but get heated up without realizing it."

A close classmate and friend of Kazuya and Ritsu, whom they see every morning on the bus. Though he is a member of the art club, histall stature often leads people to mistake him for a basketball club member.

An art enthusiast with a straightforward personality.

[Translated from [url=https://nenaico.com/samaao/chara08.html]official website[/url]]
